original_target.title: Global regularity of the three-dimensional Navier–Stokes equations

scope_comparison: The primary September166-page manuscript Theorem1.1 has a smooth nonzero force, zero initial velocity and arbitrary positive viscosity; torus Corollary10.6 retains forcing. Unforced Euler blowup is inviscid. Critical-regularity NS nonuniqueness has rough initial data. None establishes failure of continuation for an unforced periodic smooth datum. Palomar singular-set bounds and conditional integrability criteria do not eliminate the singular set for all data.
